summary: Last-known-zone restoration correlates with blank rendering in several apps.

judgment.rationale: Last-known-zone restoration correlates with blank rendering in several apps. Hypothesis: early restoration changes placement/show state before application rendering initialization; shared symptoms do not prove a single root cause. This is an initial investigation direction, not a runtime-confirmed diagnosis.
evidence: Full discussion reports Illustrator and LocalSend rendering failures when last-known-zone restoration is enabled.
Later replies extend the issue to multiple applications; there is no actual unanswered reporter question justifying the old waiting-on-author state.
This is the last-known-zone setting, not necessarily the Flutter active-monitor case #52000.
